name: Shop: combines two articles when the question needs both
description: The customer asks two things: when the refund arrives, and who pays return shipping for a damaged item. Each answer is in a different article. The draft must answer both and cite both.

input.subject: Damaged lamp
input.body: My lamp arrived with a cracked base. If I send it back, do I have to pay for shipping? And how long until I get my money?

knowledge.title: Refund policy
knowledge.content: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return.

knowledge.title: Store pickup
knowledge.content: Orders marked for pickup are held at the store for 7 days.

knowledge.title: Damaged or faulty items
knowledge.content: If an item arrives damaged, return shipping is free: we email a prepaid label. Please include a photo of the damage in your return request.

mock.text:
Hi Omar, sorry the lamp arrived cracked. Return shipping is free for damaged items: we'll email you a prepaid label, and please include a photo of the damage with your return request. Once we receive the lamp, the refund goes to your original payment method within 5 business days.

Best,
Support
[sources: K3, K1]

mustMatch: free|no cost|won't (have to )?pay|don't (have to|need to) pay
